Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1068
Claimant:
Eric Solis
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
1-30-24
The claim was reported by the insured's attorney following a side impact at a signalized intersection, and the claimant
describes a concussion from the collision. The file has been opened and assigned for review.
2-14-24
Confirmed that the driver is listed on the policy and that the policy was in force on the date of loss. No issues with
coverage have srufaced at this stage.
2-15-24
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the time of the crash. Photos taken at the
scene show damgae consistent with the described impact.
4-3-24
Reviewed the photos and the body shop estimate. The vehicle damage lines up with a side impact of the type the
claimant describes, and no earlier damage to the vehicle is known from our records or the prior inspection.
4-6-24
Spoke with counsel, who confirmed the claimant's treatment plan and provided medical records. The concussion
diagnosis is plausible for a crash of this nature, and no prior injury to the head or neck has been identified.
4-28-24
Medical treatment has run somewhat longer than is typical for this injury. I've requested updated records from the
treating provider to understand the reasons for the extended course.
5-27-24
Took a recorded follow-up statement from the claimant through counsel. The claimant added a few small details that
were not in the first account, but the core description of the collision has remained the same.
8-17-24
No independent witnesses have come forward, so the file rests on the police report, the scene photos, and the
claimant's statements. These sources agree on the basic facts of the loss.
8-21-24
Reviewed the file as a whole. The injury and vehicle damage are consistent with the reported loss, and nothing in the
file points to a pre-existing condition or damage predating coverage. Continuing to monitor the extended treatment
period before setting a resolution path.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
